resource.description: Coverage evidence: one assembled row for one named asset from the dated coverage record, not a live chain read. Returns identity, measurement state with method and measured_at, provenance digests, and this record's honest anchor state: evidence packs UNSIGNED (0 signed) until signing runs. States exactly as recorded: DEEP_MEASURED, UNMEASURED_REASON_DOCUMENTED (reason included) or INDEXED_METADATA_ONLY. Free preview gives identity, state and as_of; verification is free on the public board.

asset.description: numeric DefiLlama stablecoin id (or a symbol; collisions return 409 with candidates)

preview.description: free preview: identity + state + as_of only

signature.description: JWS compact serialization containing the offer payload

csoai.lid: 23 axes measured · 14 model comparisons: 0 separated · 7 TIE · 7 UNTESTED · 9 fact runs · TIE is TIE · not a certificate.
csoai.deliverable: one assembled JSON evidence row for the named asset: canonical identity, measurement state + method + measured_at (or the published reason), provenance digests (canonical version + SHA-256), and this record's honest anchor state

offer_receipt.verify: base64url-decode the JWS payload part, fetch https://csoai.org/.well-known/did.json, take the publicKeyJwk.x of the verificationMethod whose id equals the header kid, and verify Ed25519 over `header.payload`. POST the compact string to /api/receipts/verify to have us do it, or run the same-site https://councilof.ai/verifier/verify_receipt.py checker. Default mode reads the public DID document; saved-key replay can be offline. Signature validity is not proof of settlement.
